_notes: PixelKin elemental type chart. Authoritative source for both the game engine and the balance simulator (tools/balance). chart[ATTACKER][DEFENDER] = damage multiplier; any pair not listed defaults to 1.0 (neutral). Mirrors docs/mechanics/01-type-system.md (keep in sync). The ten types are the eight constellation elements (Ember, Tide, Verdant, Stone, Storm, Frost, Solar, Lunar) plus the universal Light/Dark axis from the Vesperholm story bible. Two deliberate 'mirror' axes deal mutual super-effective damage for climactic, swingy matchups: Solar<->Lunar (day vs night) and Light<->Dark (radiance vs the Hollowing's null).
